eng:

<hr>Ward
<hr><ev>Evolve: Do this X times: "Deal 1 damage to a random enemy follower." X is the number of Pixie followers in your hand.</ev>

        buff $self +count(self:hand<Follower> All where has trait 妖精)/+count(self:hand<Follower> All where has trait 妖精)

            deal 1 damage to opponent:board<Follower> Random(1)

        repeat ctr:pixie_followers_hand times:
            deal 1 damage to opponent:board<Follower> Random(1)

name: 破坏的祈祷者
eng:

<hr><ev>Evolve: Replicate the effects of this card's Fanfare ability.</ev>
pack:
fanfare:
        select self:board other Choose(1)
        if exists($selected):
            destroy $selected
            deal 2 damage to opponent:board<Follower> Random(1)

        invoke_ability OnPlay on $self

        select self:board other Choose(1)
